attribution.title: The Mango Tree
attribution.author: Mahiti Mahesh
attribution.modified: テキスト抽出・画像リサイズ・JSON 正規化を実施

pages.text: Once upon a time there was a mango tree. The mango tree did not have any friend. He was very sad. He was so sad that he started to cry. Then one day a bird came and sat on the tree. The bird asked the tree why he was crying. The tree did not tell the bird why he was crying. So the bird just sat there.
